## 1. Chargement

```{r}
library(xts)        # séries temporelles
library(tseries)    # Jarque-Bera
library(forecast)   # Arima, auto.arima, forecast
library(jsonlite)   # lire split.json
set.seed(42)        # reproductibilité

raw <- read.csv("data/btc_eth.csv")                       # même csv que Python
raw$date <- as.Date(raw$date)
x <- xts(raw[, c("btc_close", "eth_close")], order.by = raw$date)
x$btc_logp <- log(x$btc_close)                            # log-prix BTC
x$eth_logp <- log(x$eth_close)                            # log-prix ETH

split <- fromJSON("data/split.json")                      # même split que Python
train_end  <- as.Date(split$train_end)
test_start <- as.Date(split$test_start)

H <- 10      # horizon de prévision (10 jours)
D <- 1       # ordre de différenciation (conclu par ADF/KPSS)

cat("Train jusqu'au", split$train_end, "| test à partir du", split$test_start, "\n")

```
## 2. ACF / PACF du log-prix différencié
```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))                            # 4 graphes sur une page
for (a in c("btc", "eth")) {
  y <- as.numeric(x[paste0("/", train_end), paste0(a, "_logp")])    # log-prix, train seulement
  acf(diff(y), lag.max = 30, main = paste(toupper(a), "- ACF diff log-prix"))
  pacf(diff(y), lag.max = 30, main = paste(toupper(a), "- PACF diff log-prix"))
}
```
## 3. Choix des ordres

```{r}
ordres <- data.frame()                                   # tableau des résultats
for (a in c("btc", "eth")) {
  y <- as.numeric(x[paste0("/", train_end), paste0(a, "_logp")])

  # grille manuelle : p, q de 0 à 2, sans et avec dérive
  for (p in 0:2) for (q in 0:2) for (drift in c(FALSE, TRUE)) {
    m <- Arima(y, order = c(p, D, q), include.drift = drift, method = "ML")
    ordres <- rbind(ordres, data.frame(actif = toupper(a), methode = "manuelle",
                                       p = p, q = q, drift = drift, AIC = m$aic, BIC = m$bic))
  }

  # sélection automatique
  auto <- auto.arima(y, d = D, seasonal = FALSE, ic = "aic", stepwise = TRUE, approximation = FALSE)
  o <- arimaorder(auto)                                  # ordres choisis (p, d, q)
  drift <- "drift" %in% names(coef(auto))                # dérive incluse ou non
  m <- Arima(y, order = o, include.drift = drift, method = "ML")
  ordres <- rbind(ordres, data.frame(actif = toupper(a), methode = "auto.arima",
                                     p = o[1], q = o[3], drift = drift, AIC = m$aic, BIC = m$bic))
}

dir.create("results/tables", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(ordres, "results/tables/02_selection_ordres_R.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# top 5 par BIC pour chaque actif
for (a in c("BTC", "ETH")) {
  t <- ordres[ordres$actif == a, ]
  print(head(t[order(t$BIC), ], 5), digits = 7)
}
```
## 4. Diagnostic des résidus et SARIMA

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
# test ARCH-LM d'Engle (écrit à la main)
arch_lm <- function(e, lags = 10) {
  X <- embed(e^2, lags + 1)                                   # e² et ses 10 retards
  stat <- nrow(X) * summary(lm(X[, 1] ~ X[, -1]))$r.squared   # n * R²
  c(stat = stat, p = 1 - pchisq(stat, lags))                  # suit un Chi2(10) sous H0
}

retenus <- list()       # modèles gardés pour les prévisions
diags <- data.frame()

for (a in c("btc", "eth")) {
  y <- as.numeric(x[paste0("/", train_end), paste0(a, "_logp")])
  t <- ordres[ordres$actif == toupper(a), ]

  for (crit in c("BIC", "AIC")) {
    b <- t[which.min(t[[crit]]), ]                            # meilleur modèle selon le critère
    deja <- Filter(function(r) r$a == a && !isTRUE(r$saison) &&
                     r$p == b$p && r$q == b$q && r$drift == b$drift, retenus)
    if (length(deja) > 0) next                                # même modèle que le BIC -> on saute
    retenus[[length(retenus) + 1]] <- list(a = a, crit = crit, p = b$p, q = b$q, drift = b$drift)

    m <- Arima(y, order = c(b$p, D, b$q), include.drift = b$drift, method = "ML")
    e <- as.numeric(residuals(m))[-1]                         # résidus (sans le 1er)
    k <- length(coef(m))                                      # nb de paramètres estimés
    nom <- sprintf("%s ARIMA(%d,1,%d)%s (%s)", toupper(a), b$p, b$q,
                   ifelse(b$drift, " + derive", ""), crit)

    diags <- rbind(diags, data.frame(
      modele    = nom,
      LB_p_10   = Box.test(e, lag = 10, type = "Ljung-Box", fitdf = k)$p.value,   # autocorrélation
      LB_p_20   = Box.test(e, lag = 20, type = "Ljung-Box", fitdf = k)$p.value,
      JB_p      = jarque.bera.test(e)$p.value,                                    # normalité
      Shapiro_p = shapiro.test(tail(e, 5000))$p.value,
      ARCH_LM_p = arch_lm(e)["p"]))                                               # effet ARCH

    checkresiduals(m, test = FALSE)                           # graphes des résidus
  }

  # SARIMA : saisonnalité hebdo (s = 7) ajoutée au dernier modèle
  sar <- Arima(ts(y, frequency = 7), order = c(b$p, D, b$q), seasonal = c(1, 0, 1),
               include.drift = b$drift, method = "ML")
  z <- coef(sar)[c("sar1", "sma1")] / sqrt(diag(sar$var.coef))[c("sar1", "sma1")]   # stat z
  p_saison <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z)))                                                # p-values
  garder <- (sar$aic < m$aic) && any(p_saison < 0.05)
  cat(toupper(a), "SARIMA : AIC", round(sar$aic, 1), "vs ARIMA", round(m$aic, 1),
      "| p saisonniers", round(p_saison, 4), ifelse(garder, "-> gardé", "-> rejeté"), "\n")
  if (garder) retenus[[length(retenus) + 1]] <- list(a = a, crit = "SARIMA", p = b$p, q = b$q,
                                                     drift = b$drift, saison = TRUE)
}

rownames(diags) <- NULL
write.csv(diags, "results/tables/02_diagnostic_residus_R.csv", row.names = FALSE)
print(diags, digits = 3)
```
## 5. Prévisions et évaluation

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
# prévision à 10 jours depuis une origine sur 10 dans le test
rolling_origin <- function(a, prevoir) {
  lp   <- x[, paste0(a, "_logp")]
  prix <- x[, paste0(a, "_close")]
  origines <- seq(test_start, end(x), by = 10)                    # une origine tous les 10 jours
  origines <- origines[origines + H - 1 <= end(x)]                # assez de jours pour comparer
  do.call(rbind, lapply(origines, function(o) {
    hist  <- as.numeric(lp[paste0("/", o - 1)])                   # seulement le passé
    f     <- prevoir(hist)
    dates <- seq(o, by = "day", length.out = H)
    data.frame(origin = o, date = dates, h = 1:H, y_true = as.numeric(prix[dates]),
               y_pred = exp(f$moy), lo95 = exp(f$bas), hi95 = exp(f$haut))   # retour en USD
  }))
}

# ARIMA / SARIMA ré-estimé à chaque origine
prev_arima <- function(p, q, drift, saison = FALSE) {
  force(p); force(q); force(drift); force(saison)                 # fige les paramètres
  function(hist) {
    m <- if (saison) Arima(ts(hist, frequency = 7), order = c(p, D, q), seasonal = c(1, 0, 1),
                           include.drift = drift, method = "ML")
         else Arima(hist, order = c(p, D, q), include.drift = drift, method = "ML")
    fc <- forecast(m, h = H, level = 95)                          # prévision + IC 95 %
    list(moy = as.numeric(fc$mean), bas = as.numeric(fc$lower), haut = as.numeric(fc$upper))
  }
}

# baselines
naive_f <- function(hist) list(moy = rep(tail(hist, 1), H), bas = rep(NA, H), haut = rep(NA, H))  # demain = aujourd'hui
drift_f <- function(hist) {                                                                      # tendance moyenne
  pente <- (tail(hist, 1) - hist[1]) / (length(hist) - 1)
  list(moy = tail(hist, 1) + pente * (1:H), bas = rep(NA, H), haut = rep(NA, H))
}

# métriques sur le prix en USD
metriques <- function(fc) {
  e <- fc$y_true - fc$y_pred
  data.frame(MSE = mean(e^2), RMSE = sqrt(mean(e^2)), MAE = mean(abs(e)),
             MAPE = 100 * mean(abs(e / fc$y_true)))
}

resultats <- data.frame()
for (a in c("btc", "eth")) {
  # liste des modèles à évaluer pour cet actif
  candidats <- list()
  for (r in Filter(function(r) r$a == a, retenus)) {
    nom <- if (isTRUE(r$saison)) paste0("SARIMA(", r$p, ",1,", r$q, ")(1,0,1)[7]")
           else paste0("ARIMA(", r$p, ",1,", r$q, ") (", r$crit, ")")
    candidats[[length(candidats) + 1]] <- list(nom = nom, code = paste0("arima_", tolower(r$crit)),
                                               f = prev_arima(r$p, r$q, r$drift, isTRUE(r$saison)))
  }
  candidats <- c(candidats, list(list(nom = "Naive", code = "naive", f = naive_f),
                                 list(nom = "Drift", code = "drift", f = drift_f)))

  for (cd in candidats) {
    t0 <- Sys.time()
    fc <- rolling_origin(a, cd$f)
    duree <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))
    write.csv(fc, paste0("results/tables/forecasts_", cd$code, "_", a, "_R.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    couv <- if (all(is.na(fc$lo95))) NA else mean(fc$y_true >= fc$lo95 & fc$y_true <= fc$hi95)
    resultats <- rbind(resultats, cbind(data.frame(actif = toupper(a), modele = cd$nom),
                                        metriques(fc), couverture_IC95 = couv, temps_s = duree))

    # graphe : observé + prévisions + IC 95 %
    if (startsWith(cd$code, "arima")) {
      obs <- x[paste0(test_start, "/"), paste0(a, "_close")]
      plot(index(obs), as.numeric(obs), type = "l", xlab = "", ylab = "USD",
           ylim = range(c(as.numeric(obs), fc$lo95, fc$hi95), na.rm = TRUE),
           main = paste(toupper(a), "-", cd$nom))
      for (o in unique(fc$origin)) {
        g <- fc[fc$origin == o, ]
        polygon(c(g$date, rev(g$date)), c(g$lo95, rev(g$hi95)), col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.15), border = NA)
        lines(g$date, g$y_pred, col = "blue")
      }
    }
  }
}

write.csv(resultats, "results/tables/02_metriques_R.csv", row.names = FALSE)
print(resultats, digits = 4)
```
